summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory developments impacting the retail and capital markets in India.

bullets.text: Supreme Court ruled builders' RERA violations cannot criminally implicate lenders, clarifying liability in real estate transactions.
India’s capital markets raised Rs 10 lakh crore annually, with market capitalization surpassing $5 trillion, according to SEBI.
Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network to compete with Starlink in India, enhancing its tech capabilities.
Titan's Helios Luxe aims to open 40-50 stores within 3 years, targeting the Rs 13,000 crore accessible luxury watch market.
CJI Surya Kant stated there is no religious bias in case reassignments, indicating potential for more similar adjustments in future.
